description: Return a single skill's stored package primary SKILL.md body. Response is flat (no wrapper): id, name, content, node_path, source, version_id, updated_at. For source='github_ref', reads the approved Pathrule snapshot, not live GitHub. version_id is the optimistic concurrency token for pathrule_update_skill. Legacy response.skill.* wrapper removed in M14.
name: pathrule_read_skill
title: Read Skill
